title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 1,101–1,150 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: Electric vehicles are becoming increasingly popular in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 電動車在台灣越來越受到歡迎。

examples.en: Heavy goods vehicles are not permitted on this residential road.
examples.zh: 大型貨運車輛不得行駛於這條住宅區道路。

examples.en: Make sure all passengers exit the vehicle safely.
examples.zh: 確保所有乘客都已安全下車。

examples.en: Riding a heavy motorcycle requires a special license.
examples.zh: 騎乘大型重型機車需要考取專用駕照。

examples.en: He spent the entire afternoon polishing his classic motorcycle.
examples.zh: 他花了一整個下午擦拭保養他的經典重機。

examples.en: Motorcyclists should always stay vigilant at intersections.
examples.zh: 機車騎士在十字路口應隨時保持警覺。

examples.en: Scooters are the most common mode of transport in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 機車是台灣最普遍的代步交通工具。

examples.en: She commutes to work on her electric scooter every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早晨騎著電動機車通勤上班。

examples.en: Renting a scooter is a convenient way to explore the island.
examples.zh: 租一輛機車是探索這座島嶼的便利方式。

examples.en: Always strap your safety helmet securely before riding.
examples.zh: 騎車前請務必將安全帽確實扣緊。

examples.en: Construction workers must wear hard helmets on the building site.
examples.zh: 工地工人必須在建築工地上佩戴安全帽。

examples.en: The bicycle helmet protected his head during the fall.
examples.zh: 自行車安全帽在他摔倒時保護了他的頭部。

examples.en: The mechanic checked the car engine thoroughly.
examples.zh: 技師徹底檢查了汽車引擎。

examples.en: Strange rattling noises came from the old aircraft engine.
examples.zh: 老舊飛機引擎發出奇怪的喀喀聲響。

examples.en: Turn off the engine while waiting at the railway crossing.
examples.zh: 在平交道等候時請將發動機熄火。

examples.en: A bicycle has two wheels, while a car has four.
examples.zh: 腳踏車有兩個車輪，而汽車有四個。

examples.en: The front wheel of the cart squeaked loudly as it turned.
examples.zh: 手推車的前輪在轉彎時發出刺耳的吱吱聲。

examples.en: He took the wheel and drove us through the heavy thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 他握住方向盤，載著我們穿過了猛烈的雷陣雨。

examples.en: Keep both hands firmly on the steering wheel while driving.
examples.zh: 開車時雙手請穩握方向盤。

examples.en: The luxury sports car features a leather-wrapped steering wheel.
examples.zh: 這款豪華跑車配備了真皮包覆的方向盤。

examples.en: She adjusted the steering wheel to a comfortable driving height.
examples.zh: 她將方向盤調整到舒適的駕駛高度。

examples.en: Check the tire pressure before setting off on a road trip.
examples.zh: 開車出遊前請先檢查輪胎胎壓。

examples.en: He learned how to replace a flat tire on the side of the highway.
examples.zh: 他學會了如何在公路旁更換洩氣的扁胎。

examples.en: Working twelve hours without a break will tire anyone out.
examples.zh: 連續工作十二小時不休息會讓任何人都感到疲累。

examples.en: Step on the brake pedal gently to bring the car to a halt.
examples.zh: 輕踩煞車踏板使車輛平穩停下。

examples.en: The bicycle brakes failed when he was going downhill.
examples.zh: 他的腳踏車煞車在下坡時失靈了。

examples.en: Drivers must brake quickly when an animal darts into the road.
examples.zh: 當動物突然衝到路上時，駕駛必須迅速踩煞車。

examples.en: We need to stop at the service station to fill up on gas.
examples.zh: 我們需要停在休息站加油。

examples.en: Turn off the gas valve properly after cooking dinner.
examples.zh: 煮完晚餐後請務必將瓦斯閥門確實關緊。

examples.en: Natural gas is widely used for residential home heating.
examples.zh: 天然氣被廣泛應用於一般住宅供暖。

examples.en: Hybrid cars consume significantly less fuel in city traffic.
examples.zh: 油電車在市區行駛時消耗顯著較少的燃料。

examples.en: Rising fuel prices have increased international shipping costs.
examples.zh: 燃油價格上漲增加了國際航運成本。

examples.en: His harsh criticism only fueled their determination to win.
examples.zh: 他嚴厲的批評反而更加激發了他們獲勝的決心。

examples.en: Do not exceed the speed limit on winding mountain roads.
examples.zh: 在蜿蜒山路上切勿超速行駛。

examples.en: The high-speed train travels at over three hundred kilometers per hour.
examples.zh: 高速列車以超過每小時三百公里的速度行駛。

examples.en: You need to speed up if you want to catch the last bus.
examples.zh: 如果你想趕上末班公車，就必須加快腳步。

examples.en: The speed limit on Taiwan's National Freeway No. 1 is 100 km/h.
examples.zh: 台灣國道一號的最高速限為每小時 100 公里。

examples.en: Drivers who exceed the speed limit will face heavy monetary fines.
examples.zh: 超速行駛的駕駛將面臨高額罰金處罰。

examples.en: Pay attention to the speed limit signs when entering school zones.
examples.zh: 進入學校周邊區域時請留意限速標誌。

examples.en: Driving on the coastal highway offers breathtaking ocean views.
examples.zh: 行駛在濱海公路上坐擁令人屏息的壯麗海景。

examples.en: A serious traffic accident blocked two lanes on the interstate highway.
examples.zh: 一起嚴重的交通事故封閉了州際公路的兩條車道。

examples.en: We took the scenic highway instead of the congested city streets.
examples.zh: 我們選擇行駛風景優美的公路，避開了擁擠的市區街道。

examples.en: Motorcyclists should stay inside the dedicated scooter lane.
examples.zh: 機車騎士應行駛在機車專用道內。

examples.en: Vehicles must signal before changing into the passing lane.
examples.zh: 車輛在變換至超車道前必須打方向燈。

examples.en: A quaint stone lane wound through the historic mountain village.
examples.zh: 一條古雅的石板小巷蜿蜒穿過這座歷史悠久的山村。

examples.en: The Hsuehshan Tunnel connects New Taipei and Yilan.
examples.zh: 雪山隧道連接了新北市與宜蘭縣。

examples.en: Turn on your car headlights whenever driving through a long tunnel.
examples.zh: 開車穿過長隧道時務必開啟汽車大燈。

examples.en: Workers dug an underground tunnel to expand the subway system.
examples.zh: 工人們挖掘了一條地下隧道以擴建地鐵系統。

examples.en: The Danjiang Bridge will be a stunning landmark across the river.
examples.zh: 淡江大橋將成為橫跨河面的迷人地標。

examples.en: Pedestrians can cross the busy avenue using the elevated foot bridge.
examples.zh: 行人可利用高架人行陸橋跨越繁忙的大街。

examples.en: Cultural exchange programs help bridge misunderstandings between nations.
examples.zh: 文化交流計畫有助於消除各國之間的誤解隔閡。

examples.en: All passengers are required to wear seatbelts by law.
examples.zh: 法律規定全體乘客均須繫妥安全帶。

examples.en: Flight attendants welcomed each passenger aboard the airplane.
examples.zh: 空服人員歡迎每位乘客登上飛機。

examples.en: Over a thousand passengers boarded the cruise ship for the Caribbean voyage.
examples.zh: 超過一千名旅客登上了前往加勒比海航程的郵輪。

examples.en: You must carry your driver's license when operating a car.
examples.zh: 開車上路時必須隨身攜帶駕照。

examples.en: She passed her road test on the first try and obtained her driver's license.
examples.zh: 她路考一次就通過並順利取得了駕照。

examples.en: The police officer asked to inspect the young driver's license.
examples.zh: 警員要求檢查這位年輕駕駛的駕照。

examples.en: You will get a fine for parking in a red-line zone.
examples.zh: 在紅線違規停車會收到罰單。

examples.en: The weather looks perfectly fine for an outdoor picnic.
examples.zh: 天氣看起來非常晴朗良好，很適合戶外野餐。

examples.en: The court imposed a heavy fine on the illegal dumping company.
examples.zh: 法院對非法傾倒廢棄物的公司處以重罰。

examples.en: Drive defensively to prevent serious road accidents.
examples.zh: 採取防衛性駕駛以預防嚴重的交通事故。

examples.en: I spilled hot coffee over my keyboard completely by accident.
examples.zh: 我純屬意外不小心把熱咖啡潑灑在鍵盤上。

examples.en: Emergency medics responded swiftly to the factory accident.
examples.zh: 緊急救護人員對工廠發生的意外事件迅速做出了處置。

examples.en: The mechanic repaired my punctured bicycle tire quickly.
examples.zh: 技師迅速修補了我被刺破的腳踏車輪胎。

examples.en: Road repair work caused minor traffic delays during rush hour.
examples.zh: 道路修繕工程在尖峰時段造成了輕微的交通延誤。

examples.en: It will cost several hundred dollars to repair the broken smartphone screen.
examples.zh: 修理破碎的手機螢幕需要花費數百美元。

examples.en: Finding an available parking space in Taipei can be challenging.
examples.zh: 在台北市要找到可用的停車位可能頗具挑戰。

examples.en: Do not occupy the designated handicapped parking space without a permit.
examples.zh: 未經許可切勿佔用無障礙專用停車位。

examples.en: The modern apartment complex offers one underground parking space per unit.
examples.zh: 這棟現代化公寓大樓每戶皆配有一個地下停車位。

examples.en: We were stuck in a heavy traffic jam on the freeway.
examples.zh: 我們在高速公路上被困在嚴重的車陣中。

examples.en: Bad weather and road construction often result in severe traffic jams.
examples.zh: 惡劣天候和道路施工經常導致嚴重的交通壅塞。

examples.en: Leaving early in the morning helps you avoid peak-hour traffic jams.
examples.zh: 清晨提早出門有助於避開尖峰時段的塞車車潮。

collocations: get stuck in a traffic jam

examples.en: Check the GPS navigation for the fastest driving route.
examples.zh: 查閱 GPS 導航以獲取最快速的行車路線。

examples.en: The city added a new bus route serving remote suburban communities.
examples.zh: 市政府新增了一條服務偏遠郊區社區的公車路線。

examples.en: Hikers followed a well-marked mountain route up to the summit.
examples.zh: 登山客沿著標示清晰的登山路徑一路登上山頂。

examples.en: Is there a direct train from Taipei to Taitung?
examples.zh: 請問有從台北直達台東的火車嗎？

examples.en: The teacher gave clear and direct instructions for the test.
examples.zh: 老師對考試給予了明確直接的指示。

examples.en: Police officers were deployed to direct heavy traffic around the stadium.
examples.zh: 警官被派往體育場周圍指揮疏導繁忙的交通。

examples.en: Transfer to the Red Line at Taipei Main Station.
examples.zh: 請在台北車站轉乘紅線捷運。

examples.en: He transferred money from his checking account to pay the rent.
examples.zh: 他從支票帳戶轉帳以支付房租。

examples.en: The university allows students to transfer course credits between departments.
examples.zh: 該大學允許學生在各系所之間辦理學分抵免轉移。

examples.en: Stand behind the yellow safety line on the train platform.
examples.zh: 請在火車月台的黃色安全線後方等候。

examples.en: The politician stepped onto the platform to deliver his campaign speech.
examples.zh: 這位政治人物走上講台發表他的競選演說。

examples.en: This online streaming platform provides thousands of documentary films.
examples.zh: 這個線上串流影音平台提供了數千部紀錄片。

examples.en: The Taroko Express train offers a fast journey to Hualien.
examples.zh: 太魯閣號特快車提供前往花蓮的便捷旅程。

examples.en: Be sure to buy tickets in advance because express trains sell out early.
examples.zh: 請務必提早買票，因為特快車往往很早就售罄。

examples.en: Unlike local commuter trains, the express train skips smaller stations.
examples.zh: 與區間普通車不同，特快車不會停靠較小的車站。

examples.en: The Taiwan High Speed Rail connects Taipei and Zuoying in 90 minutes.
examples.zh: 台灣高鐵在 90 分鐘內連結台北與左營。

examples.en: Taking the High Speed Rail is the most efficient way to travel across western Taiwan.
examples.zh: 搭乘高鐵是穿梭台灣西部走廊最高效的旅行方式。

examples.en: Discounted early-bird tickets are available on the High Speed Rail website.
examples.zh: 高鐵官方網站上提供限量的早鳥優惠折扣車票。

examples.en: Our reserved seats are in train carriage number six.
examples.zh: 我們的劃位座位在火車第六節車廂。

examples.en: Cinderella rode to the palace ball in a magical pumpkin carriage.
examples.zh: 灰姑娘搭乘神奇的南瓜馬車前往皇宮舞會。

examples.en: Passengers should maintain silence in the designated quiet carriage.
examples.zh: 乘客在專屬的靜音車廂內應當保持肅靜。

examples.en: Place your heavy suitcases on the luggage rack near the door.
examples.zh: 將厚重行李箱放在靠近車門處的行李架上。

examples.en: He lifted his travel bag onto the overhead luggage rack.
examples.zh: 他把旅行提袋放到了頭頂上方的行李置物架上。

examples.en: Ensure all backpacks on the luggage rack are securely balanced before the train moves.
examples.zh: 列車啟動前，請確認行李架上的所有背包都已平穩放置。

examples.en: You can tap your EasyCard to pay the bus fare.
examples.zh: 你可以感應悠遊卡來支付公車車資。

examples.en: Airline fares tend to surge during the summer vacation season.
examples.zh: 機票票價往往會在暑假旅遊旺季期間飆漲。

examples.en: Senior citizens enjoy discounted public transport fares nationwide.
examples.zh: 全國年長者搭乘大眾運輸工具享有優惠折扣票價。

examples.en: The train conductor inspected tickets during the ride.
examples.zh: 列車長在列車行駛途中進行查票。

examples.en: The orchestra conductor raised his baton and the music began.
examples.zh: 管弦樂團指揮揚起指揮棒，美妙的樂音隨即奏響。

examples.en: Copper is widely recognized as an excellent electrical conductor.
examples.zh: 銅被公認為極為優良的導電體。

examples.en: EVA Air and China Airlines are Taiwan's major airlines.
examples.zh: 長榮航空與中華航空是台灣的主要航空公司。

examples.en: Which airline offers the cheapest flights to London?
examples.zh: 哪一家航空公司提供飛往倫敦最便宜的航班？

examples.en: The budget airline charges extra fees for checked baggage.
examples.zh: 這家廉價航空公司對託運行李額外收取費用。

words.definition: 辦理登機／入住手續；報到

examples.en: Complete online check-in twenty-four hours before departure.
examples.zh: 在起飛前二十四小時先完成線上報到。

examples.en: Hotel check-in typically begins after three o'clock in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 飯店入住手續通常在下午三點過後開始辦理。

examples.en: Long queues formed in front of the international airport check-in counter.
examples.zh: 國際機場報到櫃檯前排起了長長的隊伍。

examples.en: Check the digital departure board for your flight status.
examples.zh: 查看電子出發時刻看板以了解您的航班動態。

examples.en: All passengers should arrive at the gate thirty minutes before departure.
examples.zh: 全體旅客應於起飛前三十分鐘抵達登機門。

examples.en: His sudden departure from the company surprised everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 他突然從公司離職令辦公室裡的每個人都深感震驚。

examples.en: We will meet our visiting foreign friends at the arrival hall.
examples.zh: 我們將在機場入境接機大廳迎接來訪的外國友人。

examples.en: The flight arrival was delayed by poor weather conditions.
examples.zh: 航班抵達時間因惡劣天候狀況而有所延誤。

examples.en: On arrival at the hotel, guest luggage was taken directly to their suites.
examples.zh: 抵達飯店時，客人的行李被直接送往了他們的套房。

examples.en: The flight departure was delayed by two hours due to heavy fog.
examples.zh: 由於濃霧，該航班起飛時間延誤了兩小時。

examples.en: Don't delay in seeking medical advice if symptoms persist.
examples.zh: 若症狀持續未消，請勿拖延就醫諮詢。

examples.en: Technical difficulties caused an unexpected delay in the live broadcast.
examples.zh: 技術故障導致現場直播節目發生了意料之外的延遲。

examples.en: Passengers boarding for Tokyo should proceed to Gate B7.
examples.zh: 前往東京的登機旅客請前往 B7 號登機門。

examples.en: Don't forget to close and lock the front garden gate.
examples.zh: 別忘了將前花園大門關好並上鎖。

examples.en: Boarding will conclude ten minutes before the flight gate closes.
examples.zh: 登機手續將在登機門關閉前十分鐘結束。

examples.en: Pick up your checked suitcases at baggage claim carousel 3.
examples.zh: 請在三號行李轉盤處提領您的託運行李。

examples.en: We waited over half an hour at the baggage claim area for our luggage.
examples.zh: 我們在行李提領區等了半個多小時才拿到行李。

examples.en: Follow airport signs toward the baggage claim exit after clearing border control.
examples.zh: 通過邊境管制後，請沿著機場指示標誌前往行李提領出口。

examples.en: Declare any fresh agricultural products when passing customs.
examples.zh: 通過海關時，若攜帶任何新鮮農產品必須申報。

examples.en: The border customs officer inspected our declaration forms carefully.
examples.zh: 邊境海關官員仔細檢查了我們的申報單。

examples.en: It took almost an hour to pass through airport customs and immigration.
examples.zh: 通過機場海關與移民審查關卡花了將近一個小時。

examples.en: The local currency used in Taiwan is the New Taiwan Dollar (NTD).
examples.zh: 台灣使用的本地貨幣為新台幣（NTD）。

examples.en: Most European Union nations adopted the Euro as their common currency.
examples.zh: 多數歐盟國家採用歐元作為其通用流通貨幣。

examples.en: Exchange rates between foreign currencies fluctuate on financial markets daily.
examples.zh: 各國外幣之間的匯率每天在金融市場上持續浮動。

examples.en: You can exchange US dollars for NT dollars at bank counters.
examples.zh: 您可以在銀行櫃檯將美金兌換為新台幣。

examples.en: Students from both universities participated in an academic exchange program.
examples.zh: 兩所大學的學生參加了學術文化交流計畫。

examples.en: Customers can exchange unused merchandise within seven days of purchase.
examples.zh: 顧客可在購買後七日內更換未拆封使用的商品。

examples.en: Taroko Gorge is a world-renowned travel destination.
examples.zh: 太魯閣峽谷是舉世聞名的旅遊目的地。

examples.en: We finally reached our destination after an eight-hour scenic train ride.
examples.zh: 經過八小時風景優美的火車車程後，我們終於抵達了目的地。

examples.en: The island has become a preferred destination for honeymoon vacations.
examples.zh: 這座島嶼已成為度蜜月度假的首選勝地。

examples.en: Book your hotel accommodation well in advance during holidays.
examples.zh: 連假期間請務必提前預訂飯店住宿。

examples.en: University dormitory accommodation is provided for all freshmen students.
examples.zh: 全體大學一年級新生均享有學校宿舍住宿安排。

examples.en: The travel agency arranged comfortable resort accommodation near the beach.
examples.zh: 旅行社在海灘附近安排了舒適的度假村住宿。

examples.en: I made a dinner reservation for four at the hot pot restaurant.
examples.zh: 我在火鍋店預約了四個人的晚餐訂位。

examples.en: You must confirm your table reservation at least one day before dining.
examples.zh: 您必須在用餐前至少一天確認您的訂位。

examples.en: The committee expressed strong reservations about the proposed budget cut.
examples.zh: 委員會對擬議中的預算削減表達了強烈保留態度。

examples.en: You will receive a confirmation code after completing your booking.
examples.zh: 完成預訂後，您將會收到一組確認代碼。

examples.en: The popular coastal resort is completely full, so early booking is essential.
examples.zh: 這座熱門的海濱度假勝地全部客滿，因此及早預訂非常重要。

examples.en: She made an online flight booking through the travel website.
examples.zh: 她透過旅遊訂票網站辦理了線上機票預訂。

examples.en: Inquire at the front desk reception for local sightseeing maps.
examples.zh: 可向櫃檯接待處詢問以索取當地觀光導覽地圖。

examples.en: The wedding reception was held in a magnificent hotel grand ballroom.
examples.zh: 婚禮婚宴在飯店宏偉的大宴會廳隆重舉行。

examples.en: Mobile phone signal reception is poor inside deep underground tunnels.
examples.zh: 在深邃的地下隧道內，手機訊號接收狀況很差。

examples.en: The friendly hotel receptionist handed us the electronic room key cards.
examples.zh: 親切的飯店櫃檯人員將電子房卡遞交給我們。

examples.en: The dental clinic receptionist scheduled my next cleaning appointment.
examples.zh: 牙醫診所櫃檯人員為我排定了下一次洗牙預約。

examples.en: The corporate receptionist greeted visitors warmly in the main lobby.
examples.zh: 公司總機接待人員在大廳熱情迎接前來造訪的訪客。
